forward_return_assumptions.wrapper_overlay_treatment: The existing target-weighted 009826 versus VT disclosed fee gap is deducted separately. Other individual ETF expenses are not separately modeled in this single-factor forward-return input.
forward_return_assumptions.inflation_conversion_policy: Nominal institution forecasts are converted to a real return at the 2.25% midpoint. The retirement engine operates in 2026-08 real purchasing power and simulates annual CPI separately from 2.0% to 2.5%; the CPI path changes real spending and nominal cash/bond conversions but does not rescale the real equity return each year. This means nominal realized equity returns implicitly move with CPI, while the equity-inflation correlation is not separately modeled.
forward_return_assumptions.methodology_limitation: Institution forecasts are not all published on the same date, for the same benchmark universe, or with the same arithmetic/geometric convention. Medians and the target-weighted composite are a transparent planning proxy, not a harmonized consensus or a point-precise forecast.
forward_return_assumptions.model_limitation: The retirement engine applies one shared equity market factor. This target-weighted mean is a portfolio-level planning assumption at the accepted allocation; it cannot estimate the success-rate effect, separate volatility or correlation of replacing VOO with 00881.
forward_return_assumptions.long_horizon_limitation: Institutional forecasts cover roughly 10 years. Applying the weighted central estimate beyond that horizon is a planning assumption, not an institution forecast for the full retirement horizon.

global_equity_wrapper_assumptions.tax_offset_treatment: Do not estimate an unverified offset for 009826's possible avoidance of a second U.S. withholding layer on ex-U.S. dividends. global_equity_wrapper_assumptions.historical_proxy_treatment: The ten-year 009826 row remains an explicitly labeled VT history proxy and is not altered by the forward wrapper overlay.
global_equity_wrapper_assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh every semiannual review and before any material VT or 009826 allocation change; current asset size may change 009826 custody-fee tiers.

buy_first_exit_later_priority_d184.context: Steven's view: TAIEX is plausibly about to cross 50,000 points in a primary upward leg. He asked whether under-target positions can be topped up first, deferring the zero-target/legacy exit sales (006208, 00882, 009804, 2330, 2881, 2885, 2891, GOOGL, 00679B, 00751B, 00850) until after that leg completes, rather than treating a buy and a matched sell as required to occur together.
buy_first_exit_later_priority_d184.rule: This requires no gate relaxation; buys and exits already qualify independently. (1) Topping up an under-target holding (VOO's D-141 build cadence, VT's D-183 not-overheated exemption, 009826's D-143 cadence, and the four-fund high-dividend group's D-170 daily pullback top-up tiers, e.g. 00713 buying more on a deeper pullback) is funded from available cash, deposits and STOCK_ROTATION_RESERVE; it never requires a same-round matched sale of a zero-target/legacy holding. (2) Zero-target and over-limit exits remain governed only by their own D-153/D-161 high-point overheat arming and D-174 CORE_SELL_READY confirmation; they must never be sold merely because a matched buyer happens to be available this round, and never forced by a checkpoint date (D-109's priority-checkpoint dates remain management triggers, not deadlines).
buy_first_exit_later_priority_d184.priority: While a broad-market primary upward leg is plausibly still in progress (i.e. before any of the zero-target/legacy holdings individually reach their own confirmed D-153/D-161/D-174 high-overheat exit condition), daily reports should prioritize evaluating and filling under-target gaps over prospecting for a matched zero-target seller. A holding that separately reaches its own qualified high-point exit condition may still exit on its own schedule regardless of buy-side timing; its proceeds park in STOCK_ROTATION_RESERVE, subject to the applicable equity floor, if no buyer is immediately ready.
buy_first_exit_later_priority_d184.no_new_authority: This does not relax any funding floor, individual/group capacity cap, the 55% strategic equity target, the 50%-60% ordinary rebalancing band, the 40% pre-retirement rotation floor, or any other existing hard gate. A buy that would breach a cap or funding floor is still capped or blocked exactly as before; nothing here authorizes chasing a rally or forcing an unqualified sale.

Let a verified same-basis high-water mark rise while the trend continues; each tranche requires both its gain-above-anchor rung (15/20/25/30/35%) and a subsequent high-water pullback rung (3/4/5/6/8%). daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.objective: Maximize after-tax and after-cost terminal real assets subject to retirement success, P10 assets, protected-cash, allocation-floor, liquidity and evidence constraints; no rule can know or guarantee the future top.
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.one_year_high_endpoint: GET /api/quotes/one?code=<URL-encoded code>&market=<URL-encoded market>&start=<Taipei today minus one year>&end=<Taipei today>
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.one_year_high_formula: max(non-null finite positive daily highs after status, requested range, identity, freshness, ordered dates and aligned-array validation)
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.one_year_high_role: Use the verified one-year high to initialize and ratchet a never-decreasing high-water mark; it is not a requirement to sell immediately at a new high and is not a forecast of the future maximum.
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.new_high_action: Raise the high-water mark and HOLD the armed tranche; do not sell merely because a new high is printed.
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.pullback_action: After a rung is armed, recommend only the next sequential tranche when the fresh executable sell price has pulled back by at least that tranche's threshold from the verified high-water mark, remains above the locked anchor, and every existing sell, radar, liquidity, capacity, cooldown and limit-price gate passes.
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.selection_contract: Use common-random-number 3/6/9/12-month and pullback-grid sensitivities. Select a parameter set only if it has the highest median terminal real assets among candidates that do not reduce the paired retirement-success lower confidence bound or P10 terminal assets versus the no-timing strategic baseline; include all trading costs and reject an apparent winner inside simulation noise.
daily_bull_profit_capture_d156.note: A high-water pullback is an analysis trigger, never an automatic broker stop. The report may produce only a fresh limit-price recommendation backed by opposite-side depth; no order is placed. A 10% correction closes and resets the bull window after the current eligible tranche is evaluated, and unfilled budget is never forced.

retirement_countercyclical_rebalancing.pairing: Both legs use the same REBALANCE_PAIR_ID; do not breach the reserve floor, bond lower bounds, individual limits or care bridge.

rotation_equity_floor_d141.unmatched_sell_headroom_note: At 54.27% equity the 40% floor allows about 2,895,700 TWD of selling ahead of a qualified buyer, versus 866,478 TWD under the old 50% floor.
rotation_equity_floor_d141.stock_rotation_reserve_forced_deployment: Age each settled lot from T+2, not sale date; deploy the oldest amount into VOO from the 21st eligible Taiwan trading session. This is a priority ordering against idle proceeds, not a gate waiver: it overrides only discretionary batch timing and counts. It does NOT waive the 'not short-term overheated' buy gate (D-143/D-154), exact compatible radar evidence, current price, opposing book depth, settlement, funding floors, duplicate checks, individual/group/equity capacity or the shared monthly amount cap. The monthly Monte Carlo has no daily KD, radar or order-book input, so it models this deployment without those daily-only gates; that is a disclosed modelling limitation (MODEL_SPEC section 3 and OPEN_ISSUES), never a policy waiver for the daily reports. A bear window pauses rotation purchases and the idle-session clock; blocked or capacity-bound residue retains its age and explicit reason. No forced sale or fabricated fill is authorized.
rotation_equity_floor_d141.precedence: Inside the rotation window through 2028-06-30 the 40% floor governs. Equity between 40% and 50% is a disclosed rotation state, not an ordinary band breach, and does not create an obligation to buy back. The 20-session forced deployment of STOCK_ROTATION_RESERVE still applies and is the mechanism that returns equity toward target. From 2027-07-01 the ordinary 50%-60% band resumes for anything already reconciled; from 2028-07-01 it governs entirely.

two_track_consistency_d144.purpose: Three under-specified rules let the Claude and Codex tracks produce different lot counts from an identical policy bundle on 2026-09-04 09:30. Each is now a boolean the rule scanner asserts, so neither track can reintroduce its own reading.
two_track_consistency_d144.single_stock_batch_per_day_note: There is NO one-stock-per-trading-day limit and no 'earlier completion date first, others deferred' rule. Every symbol that independently clears the D-101 trigger and all section 6.8 hard gates becomes its own executable line on the same day. Only shared capacity (post-sale equity floor, rotation buy-leg capacity, fill de-duplication and the five-session cooldown) can reduce the count; when it truly binds, rank by week52Position descending, then larger excess-over-target amount, then lower symbol code, and name every deferred symbol.
two_track_consistency_d144.exit_to_zero_includes_odd_lots_note: A zero-target plan whose initial confirmed balance is at most 5,000 shares may exit in one qualified batch including odd shares. Larger plans use whole-lot baseline thirds for the first two confirmed batches, and clear the remaining shares including odd shares only in the final batch. A capacity-limited batch sells only the permitted whole lots and keeps the odd remainder until it can actually clear. Every other trim sells whole lots only. One plan baseline persists across reports; recommendations and unfilled orders never count as confirmed batches.
two_track_consistency_d144.batch_lots_formula_precedence: Class A symbols carrying a rotation-ledger baseline use one third of the plan baseline with the third batch clearing the remainder (section 6.17); class B and anything without a baseline use one third of current holdings (section 6.12). Exactly one formula applies - never both.
two_track_consistency_d144.tradability_unavailable_note: TRADABILITY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE stays L2 and its only effect is the limit price: take the first level on the opposite side of the book, rounded to a legal tick. Lot count is untouched. A hit on a disposition/attention list remains a full L1 block.
two_track_consistency_d144.twd_deposit_balance_note: D-152 removes a per-bank, demand-versus-term availability gate. A TWD buy instead passes only when the post-purchase snapshot retains at least TWD 800,000 in term deposits and at least TWD 1,550,000 in total TWD deposits. The report may disclose bank and deposit-type detail, but Steven—not the report—handles any redemption needed to make the actual debit.
twd_funding_gate_preserves: L0 item 3: /api/assets/latest holdings, totals and per-bank snapshot.deposits reconciliation remains a whole-round hard gate - that is data integrity, not an availability test
deposit amounts still feed total assets, the cash weight and all allocation maths
the D-193 emergency TWD term-deposit floor and the TWD total-deposit floor are hard post-purchase limits
sells never required funding evidence and are unaffected

USD is investment-only. The USD DCA pools all own-bank USD deposits; the TWD DCA and all TWD stock buys check the D-152 TWD floors. The actual debit bank is disclosure only. Neither path authorizes automatic redemption, currency conversion, transfer or an order.

retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.asset_value_scenario: retirement-date P10 to median from the current full model rerun
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.annual_asset_basis: Each retirement plan year's path-wise average opening and closing asset balance.
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.annual_allocation_basis: Each P10 or median disclosure uses the asset balance and whole-portfolio equity, bond and cash-like weights from the same empirical spendable-cash-income path. Source accrual includes emergency term-deposit interest and all security distributions for tax. Emergency term-deposit interest is excluded from spendable income; strategic SGOV cash distributions are included because they are spent. Emergency 00865B pays no cash distribution; its separately reconciled TWD market value is checked annually and any target gap is planned outside the baseline model. Accepted detailed holdings remain proportionally mapped within each bucket until a semiannual Accepted target review changes them.
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.annual_rate_refresh: Every model run fetches /api/assets/latest and retrieves ten rolling anniversary periods for every current and final security through /api/quotes/one for historical disclosure and volatility. D-192 stocks use a target-weighted 10-year institutional nominal forecast converted to a 3.511447% real composite at 2.25% midpoint inflation, with 1.5%/6.0% real stress sensitivities, then deduct the 009826 target-weighted incremental disclosed wrapper-fee drag; the preceding-eight-period average is diagnostic only. The shared equity factor cannot distinguish VOO from Taiwan or 00881 risk. Bond forward means use current actual-holdings YTM, effective duration and expenses from assumptions/bond_forward_yields.json, with a 45-day freshness gate. special_rate_rules.009826: Use VT as a total-return and volatility history proxy only; investor cash distribution and cash withholding are both zero. The forward equity mean separately deducts the target-weighted 0.51 percentage-point disclosed wrapper-fee gap until live tracking evidence supports a smaller drag.
special_rate_rules.00865B: Zero regular cash distribution. Forward NAV growth uses the current same-index YTM proxy net of expenses and corroborated by actual holdings; its ten-period six-actual/four-proxy history is diagnostic only.
special_rate_rules.TWD_term_deposits: Use 1.7% source-accrual and total-return yield for the current projection and refresh with Taiwan central-bank rate changes. The D-193 emergency TWD term-deposit sleeve renews its interest and excludes it from spendable cash-income reporting, while still retaining any applicable tax treatment.
special_rate_rules.all_taxes: Classify each security and ETF payment by official distribution components. Apply the 2.11% supplementary premium per chargeable payment event only when that component reaches TWD 20,000; current deposit cadence is an explicit upper-bound uncertainty and target term deposits use three equal tranches. Compare the official Taiwan combined progressive method with refundable 8.5% dividend credit against 28% separate tax. Apply 30% withholding to VOO and VT, zero investor cash withholding to 009826, 0% to SGOV, and any applicable overseas AMT; classify 00882 as overseas income. The 2027 filing includes TWD 1,348,500 gross salary (voluntary pension excluded from taxable salary) and TWD 134,850 prepayment, with only the settlement difference booked in May 2028. Recalculate after any large disposal and semiannual review.

retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.post_retirement_high_dividend_glide: D-141 REMOVED. The age-60 two-thirds high-dividend path is deleted because it implied 36.7% of total assets against a 12% hard cap. D-143's 550,000 TWD all-accrual cash-income evidence included emergency-term interest; D-193 excludes renewed emergency-term interest from spendable cash income and treats strategic SGOV cash distributions as spent. Emergency 00865B has no cash payout; its indexed TWD market-value gap is checked and planned at annual review. High-dividend remains at the accepted 10% target and 12% cap unless a new Accepted decision changes it; the review threshold never auto-trades to an unapproved target.
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.age_60_cash_income_reference: TWD 750,000 is not a hard goal. Report after-all-tax cash income and use the protected TWD 2.25M living reserve to bridge shortfalls while waiting for a suitable stock or bond sale.
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.purchasing_power: Expenses and protected reserves are 2026-08 real TWD. CPI draws once annually within 2%-2.5%; nominal salary, tax and pension use the same path for conversion. Benefit receipt basis is explicitly recorded separately.
retirement_cashflow_estimate_at_target.note: D-194 keeps the path-wise D-139 cashflow method, applies the age-75 and age-80 spending tiers plus confirmed monthly bear/bull spending adjustments, deducts all modeled recurring taxes, reduces distributions in bear states, and books the 2030-10-16 TWD 1.4M car separately once from existing liquidity when it precedes the labor-pension receipt. Labor insurance starts no earlier than age 60 and after withdrawal from insured employment; the permanent age adjustment is prorated by completed claim-age months against age 65 and capped at 20% early or late. The later single receipt enters cash and is allocated only under then-applicable capacity and market rules. VOO is the 28.5% global core, VT is a 3.5% global satellite, and 009826 is a 5% accumulating satellite with zero investor cash distribution. All ten periods remain visible as history; stock forward returns use the D-192 target-weighted 10-year institutional forecast (3.511447% real before the 009826 wrapper overlay; stress cases 1.5%/6.0%), and bonds use current holdings YTM. Nominal income is never compared directly with 2026-08-real spending.

D-192 uses the target-weighted 10-year institutional nominal forecast in global_equity_wrapper_assumptions.forward_return_assumptions, converts it using 2.25% midpoint inflation, deducts the target-weighted 009826 incremental wrapper-fee overlay, then numerically solves the arithmetic input. Low and high stress sensitivities apply the same overlay to 1.5% and 6.0% real core assumptions.
equity.forward_calibration: Derive arithmetic input at runtime from the shared compound target, the same period grid, observed volatility and Student-t/FX specification. No historical average is a forward mean.

bonds.note: D-139 uses target-weighted current actual-holdings YTM net of each fund's expense drag, then converts to real return; a separate unhedged USD/TWD factor remains. Ten-period history calibrates volatility and stress only.

00865B_nav_growth_calibration.warning: 3.80% is a current same-index YTM proxy, not a Cathay-published fund YTM. It is not guaranteed and NAV growth is not cash income until units are sold.

labor_retirement.policy: 3000000 is the August 2026 balance. Add employer 6% of earned regular salary after August through retirement, March raises and partial final month, plus the user-confirmed payroll-bracket employee 6% contribution. Projected account earnings use the current 1.7108% reference as simple interest on the August balance and later timed contributions; this is a planning proxy, not a guarantee on the August total. Do not add a second guarantee payment without the complete contribution/earnings history. One withdrawal after retirement and age 60; application the next day when retirement is after age 60. Cash is modeled 30 days later. Car purchase remains on 2030-10-16 from existing liquidity if the benefit has not arrived; no duplicate reservation. Bear investments use the five-batch ladder.
labor_retirement.note: The dated car event is debited once on 2030-10-16. If the labor-pension cash has already arrived it is earmarked until that date; otherwise existing liquid assets bridge the car before the later receipt. No second 1.4M deduction or reservation is allowed.

labor_insurance.indexation: Claim-cohort annual-average CPI. Compare previous-year annual average with claim-year/last-adjusted annual average; round percentage to 2 decimal places. At >=5%, increase by actual accumulated percentage from May next year, paid June-end; reset reference after adjustment. Age-based reduction or increase is permanent and uses 4% per year prorated by completed claim-age months, capped at 20%.
labor_insurance.verification_required: Planning estimate assumes the age-60 claim qualifies: insurance history must reach 15 years and insured employment must end before claim. The TWD 20,017 base benefit and highest-60-month wage/service record are not independently verified; no unverified service-year increase is added for later claims.

TWD security purchases must leave at least TWD 800,000 in term deposits and TWD 1,550,000 in total TWD bank deposits.

asset_api_funding_policy.settlement: Pool all banks by currency; TWD demand plus term less unsettled payables must retain indexed permanent/living floors. USD legs use all-bank USD deposits. stock_purchase_funding_policy_d150.bull_refill_requirement: Qualified bull market: rebuild the living-reserve component to the daily elapsed-time indexed nominal equivalent of 2026-08-real TWD 2,250,000; a shortfall is reported and never creates an automatic sale or order.
stock_purchase_funding_policy_d150.bear_deployment_rule: Qualified bear market: up to the daily elapsed-time indexed nominal equivalent of 2026-08-real TWD 1,500,000 of the living-reserve component may fund low buys, but the daily elapsed-time indexed 2026-08-real TWD 750,000 one-year floor and TWD 800,000 term-deposit floor remain hard limits.
stock_purchase_funding_policy_d150.bank_pooling: Aggregate all own settled deposits by currency across banks. No single-bank veto; assume zero transfer fees within user-confirmed free monthly allowances. No transfer is executed.
stock_purchase_funding_policy_d150.twd_deposit_balance_note: D-193: after every TWD stock or ETF buy, retain at least the indexed TWD 800,000 emergency term-deposit sleeve and TWD 1,550,000 total TWD deposits (that sleeve plus the separate 750,000 TWD living floor). The emergency 800,000 TWD-value Taiwan-listed 00865B sleeve is separately designated, is not a bank deposit, and is not an ordinary funding source.

per_symbol_radar_gate_d150.failure_action: No candidate-specific buy or sell direction, quantity, price or strong recommendation. State 今日無可執行單 for that candidate.

retirement_transition_policy.model_condition: Keep actual retirement-date holdings. Attempt qualified per-security tranches before 2027-12-31; only unfinished holdings continue to 2028-06-30. Market/evidence/settlement failures remain unfinished, never force target allocation. The baseline retirement date is 2027-06-30; D-152 separately compares 2028-04-15 and later dates against a strict 85% success target.
retirement_transition_policy.tranche_formula: D-105 checkpoints now recalculate the remaining gap and whether the D-130 daily pace remains adequate. They do not create a separate mechanical catch-up tranche or additional lot allowance.
retirement_transition_policy.bond_transition: D-130 uses one adaptive daily build for strategic 00865B/00719B/00697B. D-195: on each tw:true day execution_policy.py --bond-price-select gives at most two total lots to the below-target candidate whose live price is suitable (at least 0.3% below the 20-completed-session distribution-adjusted high, qualified premium/discount no higher than +0.3%) and deepest below that high; no suitable price means 0 lots. The Cathay emergency 00865B sleeve has a separate price-gated quota of 1 lot, or 2 lots at a 1% drawdown. The three strategic ETFs share a six-lot Taiwan-trading-week cap; unused capacity expires. Every trade still requires calendar, qualified current price, direction-opposite best-five depth, target gap eligibility, USD/TWD, currency-pooled deployable cash and deduplication evidence. A qualified abs(premiumDiscountPct) over 1% pauses buying; null premium is never price-suitable. The formal model keeps the base one-lot cadence as a proxy and does not simulate D-196 higher ceilings (impact on return and retirement risk is unmeasured).
retirement_transition_policy.global_equity_transition: Existing-portfolio transition uses D-118 high-to-low stock rotation, not a fixed symbol pair. D-182 (confirmed 2026-09-26): three existing USD broker instructions remain, split by ticker: a US$350 leg on day 5 into VT (satellite), and two US$350 legs on days 15 and 25 into VOO; the former day-25 TWD-account leg is cancelled. Funding checks pool all settled own-bank USD deposits; the actual debit bank is disclosed but never a gate, and no automatic redemption, conversion or transfer occurs. D-122 keeps 009826 observation-only through 2026-10-31. Do not breach applicable equity caps, chase highs, or sell a falling asset that is not over target.
retirement_transition_policy.missed_checkpoint_action: Record the reason and remaining capacity; do not force catch-up. Use 2027-06-30 as baseline and evaluate 2028-04-15 and later dates under D-152. Part-time work is not under consideration.

execution_policy.crash_deployment_rule: D-152 has no fixed order size. A qualified bear market may use up to TWD 1,500,000 from the three-year living reserve for low buys, but must leave TWD 800,000 in term deposits and at least TWD 1,550,000 in total TWD deposits after the purchase. USD remains investment-only. Then eligible cash and at most two-thirds of eligible bond ETFs may be used: fill four-fund high-dividend deficits to the 10% target first, then route remaining capacity to VOO and 0050 at 4:1 after all costs.

dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bull_reduced_target_release: D-156 retains one locked release budget (equity above the 50% floor) but replaces immediate selling into successive highs with profit capture after a high-water reversal. Each of five growing tranches requires its gain-above-anchor rung and its pullback-from-high-water rung; new highs ratchet the watermark and continue to hold. A 10% correction evaluates at most the next eligible tranche, then closes the window without forcing the remainder. See bull_ladder_d156. The 45% additional-overheat floor and no-automatic-below-40% protection remain discretionary extensions beyond this ladder.

bond_allocation_band_d143.transition_rotation_cap_formula: min(42%, 100% - protected_cash_weight - 40% pre-retirement rotation equity floor)
bond_allocation_band_d143.rule: 28% remains the strategic target when the protected cash floor permits it. The 24%–31% normal band is cash-floor aware rather than a forced allocation; the 10% floor is only a bear-sale safety floor, never a normal target.

dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.note: D-143 base uses only the 55% strategic target and 50%-60% ordinary rebalancing band, with neither bull nor bear tactical timing. Monthly 3/6/9/12-month tactical results are paired, separately labeled sensitivities.

step_1.allocation: pro-rata by each constituent's remaining target deficit

bear_stock_purchase_order_d143.rule: No fixed high-dividend versus market-growth split remains.

dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_window_cap_note: Relaxed global-equity and VOO caps apply only inside a verified bear window. The 12% high-dividend cap is never relaxed. After the window closes (drawdown back inside 10%), trim global equity back to 37% +/-3 over at most 24 months, only at qualified bull highs, never by selling low.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_bond_sale_order_d141: D-141 replaces 'sell the shorter duration first'. Sell bond ETFs in descending order of trailing 12-month total return. A disinflationary bear (stocks down, duration up) therefore sells 00697B first, which is the genuine rebalancing trade; an inflationary bear (stocks and bonds both down) sells 00865B first and halves the deployment size for that round. The 10% total-bond floor still binds before any of this.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_ladder_note: Lock one whole-window funding budget from eligible all-bank TWD cash plus eligible bond ETF sales (up to 2/3, total bond floor 10%), bounded by equity headroom. Five increasing batches 8/12/20/25/35%; first <=10%; five-session cooldown. Partial fill consumes a batch; wait if next actual amount cannot exceed previous. New cash during an active window does not enlarge its locked budget.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_precedence_over_rotation_d141: If a verified bear window opens during the pre-retirement or transition rotation, the bear window takes precedence: rotation buying pauses, rotation deadlines extend by the length of the window, and DEADLINE_RADAR_EXCEPTION items accrued inside the window are excluded from the incompletion rate.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_bond_sale_order_basis: Trailing 12-month TWD total return of each bond ETF (price change plus distributions, from the same /api/quotes/one series used for the ten-year diagnostics), ranked highest first among 00865B, 00719B and 00697B. SGOV keeps its own age-70-to-80 disposal rule and is not part of this ranking. Ties break to the longer effective duration. Recompute every round; never carry a previous rounds ranking.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bear_ladder_budget_basis: Lock one whole-window funding budget from eligible all-bank TWD cash plus eligible bond ETF sales (up to 2/3, total bond floor 10%), bounded by equity headroom. Five increasing batches 8/12/20/25/35%; first <=10%; five-session cooldown. Partial fill consumes a batch; wait if next actual amount cannot exceed previous. New cash during an active window does not enlarge its locked budget.
dynamic_allocation_policy_d141.bull_ladder_note: Lock one whole-window release budget (equity above the 50% floor) when trend confirmation and short-term overheat first hold. Arm five increasing batches 8/12/20/25/35% at gains of 15/20/25/30/35% above the locked anchor, but execute only after pullbacks of 3/4/5/6/8% from the never-decreasing high-water mark. execution_policy.risk_score_override: Use only the six canonical risk_score_categories and their rubric. Within each category take the highest applicable score. A category counts as evaluated only under risk_score_evidence_policy; missing, incomparable or contradictory evidence is score 0 with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT and does not count as evaluated. Defensive mode applies to risk-increasing equity buys when any evaluated category is 3, the total score is 8 or more (risk_score_bands.defensive), or fewer than four categories are evaluated; the cautious band (5-7) is disclosure only. Defensive mode never delays a mandatory risk reduction and does not by itself block D-130 defensive bond-ETF buying.
execution_policy.risk_score_evidence_policy: D-168: a category is evaluated only when the round cites at least one traceable, in-window permitted source: an official primary source retrieved this round; a specific item in the latest permitted public_info_*.json whose generatedAt is no older than three calendar days before the run date; for oil also the round's oil/gold JSON or commodity API; for semiconductor also the round's Philadelphia Semiconductor and KOSPI inputs and semiconductor_risk_inputs. If permitted sources were read and no item meets rubric level 1 or higher, the category is score 0 with VERIFIED_NO_RUBRIC_EVENT and counts as evaluated. Only when no permitted source for that category could be read, or the sources are incomparable or contradictory, is it score 0 with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT and not evaluated. All Taiwan place names treat 臺/台 as equivalent, including 台灣/臺灣, 台北/臺北, 台中/臺中, 台南/臺南, 台東/臺東 and 台西/臺西; preserve source spelling and normalize only for comparison. Category labels also treat full-width/half-width slashes as identical. D-169: the evaluated cell uses an exact yes/no status; UNVERIFIED never means VERIFIED. Facts/source/period and reason must be nonempty, with an explicit source period for evaluated rows. Insufficient or contradictory evidence anywhere in the row cannot be scored or counted as evaluated. D-170: a failed secondary source (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, UNVERIFIED or unreachable) disclosed in the facts/source cell does not negate an evaluated row that also cites a successfully read, dated permitted source; only when every source failed is the category EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT. A unique summary row must state the mode computed from risk_score_decision_policy, with matching totals and evaluated counts; presentation checks do not certify the underlying source. D-171: separate source records with semicolons or |, not commas. When failures and successes coexist, mark the successful record as 已讀: source plus its year-month/date. A detached date or period is not a readable source; all unavailable categories remain unevaluated with zero points and the appropriate defensive mode.
execution_policy.tsmc_advanced_process_trigger: Score 3 when the latest verifiable and comparable data puts TSMC advanced-process market share below 60%; disclose source, period, and node definition. Do not score 3 when definitions are incomparable or the source is not traceable.

execution_policy.risk_score_use: Mandatory disclosed policy input in every daily core and appendix. It may veto a risk-increasing equity buy only under risk_score_override; it is otherwise advisory, never changes policy files automatically, never delays a mandatory risk reduction, and never by itself blocks D-130 bond-ETF buying.

Actual support/pressure levels are computed dynamically from real price history exactly like D-171 (60-session pressure, 10-session support), never hardcoded to the NT$24.5/26 example. buy_limit_price_basis.problem: Prior US-stock reports were observed proposing buy limit prices far below the live executable price (fillable only on a severe same-day crash), apparently because an oversold/pullback entry SIGNAL level (KD, RSI5, BIAS10, W%R9, a support level, or a moving average) was reused as the LIMIT PRICE itself.
buy_limit_price_basis.rule: The entry signal (radar turning BUY_CANDIDATE/ADD_CANDIDATE, bull-drawdown stabilization evidence, and any KD/RSI/BIAS/W%R oversold reading per kd_role) decides ONLY whether a trade is authorized this round. It must never be reused as, or to derive, the limit price. The limit price is computed separately from live data so the order is realistically fillable the same session.
buy_limit_price_basis.price_basis: Use this round's successfully retrieved live US quote: the most recent trade price, or the bid/ask midpoint when both sides are available. Round to the security's normal minimum US tick (typically US$0.01). A small buffer toward the executable side is permitted to raise fill probability; the limit must not be set materially below the live quote merely to wait for a lower fill.
buy_limit_price_basis.no_fresh_quote: If no fresh, verifiable live quote (trade price or bid/ask) is available this round, the candidate is US_RADAR_REQUIRED_FAIL / no executable order today; never derive a limit price from a stale price, a prior session's close, or an estimate.
buy_limit_price_basis.note: kd_role already states this intent ("KD only adjusts the timing, priority, tranches, and limit price of an already-authorized trade") but no prior policy text spelled out a concrete US price basis; D-181 supplies one because etf_premium_discount_policy_d124's best-five-depth formula is TW-only (market=台股) and D-108 explicitly does not require US best-five depth.

minimum_profit_space_d185.rule: D-185 (2026-09-26): a US tactical candidate (radar-primary or fallback path) must show at least a 15% gap between the estimated entry price and the estimated fair/target price (前高/合理價) before it is worth recommending, net of commissions, spread, FX conversion and applicable Taiwan overseas-income tax. Steven's reasoning: US stocks have no daily price-move limit (漲跌幅限制) unlike Taiwan's 10%, so a short-term trade needs a bigger cushion to be worth the added overnight-gap and volatility risk plus round-trip costs; 15% is set higher than the equity sleeve's 8% (Taiwan, price-limit-protected) and the bond sleeve's 5% for that reason.
minimum_profit_space_d185.interacts_with: This is additional to, not a replacement for, section 3 point 4's separate 12-month base/pessimistic/optimistic reward:risk test (fallback-path candidates only, upside >= 2x downside). A radar-primary candidate that skips point 4 under D-181 still needs this 15% entry-to-target space check before recommendation.

order_check_d186.rule: D-186 (2026-09-26): before any D-133 US tactical buy may show a share count, USD limit price or amount, the report must run scripts/us_tactical_order_check.py on this round's saved candidate evidence (qualification path, radar detail, live quote, proposed limit, target price with basis, cost rates, proposed TWD notional and open tactical positions). strategic_buy_high_gate_d188.rule: D-188 (2026-09-26): VOO/VT/009826/SGOV keep their exemption from the two-low-signal buyer test, but 'not overheated' is replaced by a stricter no-buying-high gate so the portfolio does not buy high and later sell low. SGOV: its price rises steadily between monthly ex-dividend dates and drops on them, so price position is meaningless; a buy is allowed only when the current price is below the average ex-dividend-day close over the past 365 days (at least 6 ex-dates). Missing or unverifiable data blocks the buy. Applies to rotation, bear-routing, reserve-deployment and daily discretionary buys of these four; the broker's scheduled D-182 DCA debits are fixed instructions outside this gate. Run scripts/strategic_buy_gate.py on the saved same-round /api/quotes/one payloads; the gate only removes buys and never creates one. D-189 (2026-09-26): the same 52-week-position gate also governs the four high-dividend ETFs (00713/0056/00878/00919) for every discretionary buy, including the D-170 daily top-up, rotation buys and bear-routing restoration; it replaces D-170's older week52Position >= 0.95 overheat definition. Highs and lows are distribution-adjusted by subtracting later cash distributions (ex-date on or before the trading date) so a pre-ex-date high is not compared with a post-distribution price; a symbol outside non_distributing_symbols with missing or malformed dividendHistory is blocked (DIVIDEND_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED), never treated as zero dividends. emergency_reserve_policy_d193.model_limit: The baseline treats the D-193 emergency reserve as an aggregate protected real-TWD proxy for ordinary retirement solvency. It includes the currently dated car, hospitalization and dental expenses as ordinary scheduled portfolio outflows.
